# plot_date { #wass2s.plot_date }

```python
plot_date(A)
```

Plot a map of dates, interpreting values as offsets from 2024-01-01.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type             | Description                                                                         | Default    |
|--------|------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| A      | xarray.DataArray | Data array with values representing days since 2024-01-01, and dimensions 'Y', 'X'. | _required_ |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

Converts colorbar ticks to calendar dates (e.g., '01-Jan') for readability.
